lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The flank displays a highly structured grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters. These are arranged in approximately 6 horizontal rows and 12 vertical columns within the visible field. The clusters demonstrate larger radii and higher luminance in the central longitudinal axis, with a reduction in size and intensity toward the dorsal and ventral margins.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, particularly in the mid-flank region. These vertical stripes intersect with the horizontal rows of spots at regular intervals, forming distinct rectilinear nodes where the highest-intensity blobs are located.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank. They are defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels along the upper edge and a corresponding low-intensity shadow region directly beneath, extending from the post-gill region towards the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 11-13 distinct high-luminance blobs. The distribution is characterized by a higher spatial density along the anterior margin and at the base of the fin, with increased spacing between blobs toward the posterior tip.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) located beneath the ventral surface and in the vicinity of the pectoral fin, creating distinct high-contrast silhouettes against the blue water background.
